_comment: Video courses shown on The Course page. Each entry plays a single lecture video. Add a course by appending an object here — no code change needed. Each course may carry a `reflection`: two keyword questions shown when the video ends (each with `rewatchAt`, seconds into THIS video file, for the jump back), then an open `prompt` asking for the viewer's own view. Timestamps are measured against the file actually served — re-measure them whenever a video is replaced.

title.en: Telling Kōzo, Mitsumata and Gampi Apart
title.ja: 楮・三椏・雁皮を見分ける

subtitle.en: Three checks with washi from your own stock — and where they stop
subtitle.ja: お手元の和紙で試す三つの確認と、その限界

description.en: Choose two or three washi from your own stock and look at them: colour and sheen, touch and the view through the sheet, and a flex test. These checks give a first sort, not a laboratory identification. The lecture also shows where such checks stop being reliable, and why the fibre of an object has to be confirmed by analysis.
description.ja: お手元の和紙を2〜3枚選んで、色とつや、手ざわりと透かして見た様子、曲げたときの様子を確かめます。これは最初の仕分けであり、実験室での同定ではありません。こうした確認が頼りにならなくなる場面と、作品の繊維は分析で確かめる必要があることも示します。
